is: how each surface sounds: what a boot on it, a thing dropped on it and a thing dragged over it play (names in sounds.json or the catalogue), and how much of a sound it soaks up (absorbs: the share of sound energy taken at about 1 kHz, Sabine's coefficient), which a room's echo is worked out from. A material library family names its surface in data/library/materials.json (its `surface`), a variant only when it sounds unlike its family. A piece is heard by its own library finish (tools/usd/hearing.py), never by its kind's name; a baked piece that names no finish sounds as the finished floor under it, and no surface stands in for one not known
